answer_1.quote: Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs) extend LLMs to process text, images, and audio, demonstrating proficiency in tasks like visual question answering and spoken dialogue.
answer_1.outputs: textual descriptions, generated images, and synthesized audio

answer_2.quote: We use three metrics to determine image matching: MSE Copied (MSE < 90), PSNR Copied (PSNR > 30), and SIFT Copied (SIFT > 0.1)... For indirect visual data leakage, we report retrieved unique images and accurately described images by comparing ground-truth text with generated descriptions.

answer_3.quote: Following the approach of , we also adopt a model-based evaluation pipeline. In their method, a large language model is prompted to evaluate the similarity between a ground-truth caption and a candidate caption, assigning a CLAIR score from 0 to 100 along with a textual justification.
